name: tia-harness
description: Industrial-automation + Siemens TIA Portal V21 specialist harness for Claude Code. Turns a structured engineering project-spec into a compliant-by-construction, verifiable TIA project, driving the `tia` MCP server over the Openness HTTP API. Ships deterministic, MCP-free skills (spec-validate, cpu-select) that deliver value offline, plus subagents and domain guardrails.

tia_api_base.title: PLCWare API URL
tia_api_base.description: URL of the serve API that drives TIA Portal. Keep http://localhost:5000 when the editor runs on the same machine as serve; use http://<vm-ip>:5000 for a remote Windows host.

tia_mcp_mode.title: MCP mode
tia_mcp_mode.description: full (default) registers every tool. read-only registers only the read tools, so the agent cannot change the project or the PLC; it needs the MCP release that includes read-only mode (older releases ignore it). Any other value stops the MCP from starting.

tia_mcp_command.title: MCP command
tia_mcp_command.description: Launch command for the MCP server. The default npx command keeps the plugin usable on macOS, Linux, and remote hosts; the Windows app sets its bundled Node.js path when available.

tia_mcp_arg0.title: MCP first argument
tia_mcp_arg0.description: First argument to the MCP server launcher. The default keeps the plugin on npx; the Windows app sets the embedded server entry point when available.
